form_name: छात्रवृत्ति आवेदन (Scholarship Application — National Scholarship Portal)
issuing_authority: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) / state scholarship portal
note: This is the payoff form referenced in the product plan: it consumes 'annual_income' and 'caste_category' directly from a profile already populated by the income and caste certificate flows, so a returning user fills almost nothing new here.

fields.note: pre-filled from income_certificate flow if already on profile
pre-filled from caste_domicile_certificate flow if already on profile

required_supporting_docs: Caste certificate (if claiming a reserved-category scholarship)
post_fill_instructions_hi: आवेदन को राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल पर अपलोड करें और संस्थान से सत्यापन करवाएं। अंतिम तिथि से पहले जमा करना सुनिश्चित करें।
